lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: School Play. Peppa's playgroup are going to put on a play: The Little Red Riding Hood! Hooray! All the children have parts in the play! They have to practise at home!
lines.zh: 校园剧。佩奇的幼儿园要上演一出剧：《小红帽》！太好啦！所有孩子都有角色！他们得在家里练习！

lines.en: Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood. Mummy Pig has made her costume. Daddy Pig is helping Peppa practise. Okay, Peppa, what do you say? I'm Little Red Riding Hood! Very good! Then what? Um...
lines.zh: 佩奇要演小红帽。猪妈妈给她做了戏服。猪爸爸正在帮佩奇练习。好的，佩奇，你该说什么？我是小红帽！非常好！然后呢？嗯……

lines.en: I'm going to visit my grandma! I'm going to visit my grandma! Bravo, Peppa!
lines.zh: 我要去看望我的外婆！我要去看望我的外婆！太棒了，佩奇！

lines.en: Danny Dog is going to play the big bad wolf. Granddad Dog and Mummy Dog are helping him practise. I'm the big bad wolf! Try not to laugh, Danny, you should be a bit scarier! Try it like this, Danny. I'm the big bad wolf! I'm going to eat you all up! You see? Yes, that was really scary!
lines.zh: 小狗丹尼要演大灰狼。狗爷爷和狗妈妈在帮他练习。我是大灰狼！丹尼，别笑，你应该再凶一点！丹尼，像这样试试。我是大灰狼！我要把你们全都吃掉！明白了吗？是的，刚才那下真的很吓人！

lines.en: Pedro Pony is going to play the hunter. He will rescue Peppa from the big bad wolf! Um... I'm the hunter! And Pedro is a bit shy!
lines.zh: 小马佩德罗要演猎人。他要把佩奇从大灰狼手里救出来！嗯……我是猎人！而且佩德罗有点害羞！

lines.en: Um, you say: I'm going to chase you away, you big bad wolf! Um... go away, naughty wolf! Very good, Pedro!
lines.zh: 嗯，你要说：我要把你赶走，你这大灰狼！嗯……走开，坏狼！非常好，佩德罗！

lines.en: Rebecca Rabbit is going to be the grandma. What do I say, Mummy? Let's see! At the start of the play, you get locked in a cupboard by the big bad wolf! Then, right at the end of the play, you are rescued by the hunter, and you say: thank you! Thank you! Very good, Rebecca!
lines.zh: 小兔瑞贝卡要演外婆。妈妈，我该说什么呢？让我想想！在剧开头，你会被大灰狼锁进柜子里！然后在剧的最后，你被猎人救出来，你就说：谢谢你！谢谢你！非常好，瑞贝卡！

lines.en: Everyone has come to see the school play! Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to our play: The Little Red Riding Hood! First, let us meet the actors!
lines.zh: 大家都来看校园剧了！女士们先生们，欢迎观看我们的剧：《小红帽》！首先，让我们认识一下演员们！

lines.en: Meow! Please, please, for the sake of the actors, no photography, please!
lines.zh: 喵！拜托，拜托，为了演员们着想，请不要拍照！

lines.en: And now our play begins! Grandma is at home. But who is this visitor? On comes the big bad wolf! Well done, Danny!
lines.zh: 现在我们的剧正式开始！外婆在家。可这位来客是谁呢？大灰狼上场了！干得好，丹尼！

lines.en: Um, oh, dear, Danny has forgotten what he says next! Grandma, you must go in the cupboard! Go in the cupboard!
lines.zh: 嗯，哦，天哪，丹尼忘了下一句该说什么了！外婆，你必须进柜子里去！进柜子里去！

lines.en: The big bad wolf is pretending to be Grandma! I am Little Red Riding Hood! I'm going to visit my grandma! Bravo, Peppa!
lines.zh: 大灰狼在假扮外婆！我是小红帽！我要去看望我的外婆！太棒了，佩奇！

lines.en: Daddy, you must not take photos! Oops! Sorry, Peppa! Carry on!
lines.zh: 爸爸，你不能拍照！哎哟！对不起，佩奇！继续吧！

lines.en: I'm going to visit my grandma! Oh, you don't look like my grandma! What big eyes you have! What big teeth you have! You are not Grandma, you are the big bad wolf! Ooh! Help! Oh, help!
lines.zh: 我要去看望我的外婆！哦，你看起来不像我的外婆！你的眼睛好大呀！你的牙齿好大呀！你不是外婆，你是大灰狼！啊！救命！哦，救命！

lines.en: But look who is here, just in time: Pedro the Hunter! Help! Oh, help! Just in time, Pedro the hunter! Pedro is a bit shy! Pedro, would you like me to come on with you? Yes, please!
lines.zh: 不过看看谁来了，来得正是时候：猎人佩德罗！救命！哦，救命！来得正是时候，猎人佩德罗！佩德罗有点害羞！佩德罗，你想让我陪你一起上场吗？好的，麻烦你了！

lines.en: You are a very naughty wolf! I saved you, Grandma! Hooray! Thank you! Bravo! Bravo! Bravo!
lines.zh: 你是一只非常淘气的狼！我把你救出来了，外婆！太好啦！谢谢你！太精彩了！太精彩了！太精彩了！

lines.en: Pedro, you are very good! You are almost as good as me!
lines.zh: 佩德罗，你演得非常好！你几乎跟我一样棒了！
